DENGUE MANAGEMENT PROTOCOL (Version 3.1)

1. Any patient presenting with C/O fever for 2-7 days should be tested for NS1 antigen.
2. Platelet count below 20000 /uL requires admission to Ward 5 (Medicine).
3. Paracetamol 650 mg every 6 hours; avoid NSAIDs.
4. ASHA workers should follow up discharged patients on day 3.
5. Differential diagnosis includes typhoid, malaria and, rarely, Addison's disease crisis.
6. Dr. Ramesh Srivastava is the nodal officer.
